meta.name: board-meeting
meta.description: Multi-agent board meeting protocol for strategic decisions. Runs a structured 6-phase deliberation: context loading, independent C-suite contributions (isolated, no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction. Use when the user invokes /cs:boardroom, calls a board meeting, or wants structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多角色模拟会议来推演战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队讨论前先系统性地评估多个视角
copy.tagline_en: Simulate a multi-agent board meeting to deliberate strategic decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured multi-perspective deliberation before making a strategic call

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的战略问题当成一场模拟董事会：分六步走，让多个高管角色各自独立提意见，再由批评者挑战共识，然后汇总成决议，等你拍板后把最终决定和行动项存入本地文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“/cs:boardroom”或“召开董事会会议”，或想就战略问题听取多视角高管审议时触发。

say.text: /cs:boardroom 我们应不应该在 Q3 进军西班牙？
say.note: 会启动完整董事会流程。

say.text: 召开董事会会议，讨论产品方向。
say.note: 将自动选择相关高管角色。

say.text: 对于定价策略，召集高管层做一次审议。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a 6-phase board meeting for strategic questions: load context, get independent takes from exec roles, critic review, synthesis, your approval, then save the decision and actions locally.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /cs:boardroom, say "board meeting," or ask for structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.

say_en.text: /cs:boardroom Should we expand to Spain in Q3?
Call a board meeting to discuss product direction.
say_en.note: Relevant exec roles are activated automatically.

say_en.text: Gather the C-suite for a review of pricing strategy.
